Class DesktopApp

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.DesktopApp
public class DesktopApp extends javafx.application.Application
The JavaFX application. Spring starts before the window opens, so the database is migrated by then, and closes with it. The window is FXML whose controller is a Spring bean, handed the task service like any other bean. It opens in Nunito at the size the screen is designed for, or the screen's if that is less, and has no system title bar: the window's own header takes its place, the system's minimize, maximize and close buttons drawn on it, and the Task Manager's mark is its icon in the taskbar and Alt+Tab.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage stage) throws IOException
      Opens the window: loads Nunito, the FXML with its controller from Spring, and the stylesheet, and puts the header in place of the system's title bar. A failure nobody expected on the window's thread is shown in the window as a plain sentence, never as an error's trace.
